required_nodes.rationale: A production Ed25519 issuance pair reaches the actual proof-budget request byte-for-field exactly while the real control plane remains canonical-only and policy/admission results equal root-only behavior.
Principal identity mismatch fails before any request is constructed.
Principal binding-digest mismatch fails before any request is constructed.
Issuer mismatch fails before any request is constructed.
Non-exact issuance and ambiguous dual root specification fail closed.
No-root and root-only compatibility remain intact, and every need reuses the exact already-signed pair without signer invocation.
AST and source regression proof excludes issuer/signer construction, provenance verification, trust lookup, allocation, quota, admission grants, and effect grants.
Architecture advances exactly one causal gap to receiving-side provenance authentication without implementing allocation or authority.
